lines.latin: Sanctus, Sanctus, Sanctus Dóminus Deus Sábaoth.
lines.english: Holy, Holy, Holy, Lord God of hosts.

lines.latin: Pleni sunt cæli et terra glória tua.
lines.english: Heaven and earth are full of Thy glory.

lines.latin: Benedíctus qui venit in nómine Dómini.
lines.english: Blessed is He that cometh in the name of the Lord.
